## Smart phone downloads

- **Keep the next unread chapters ready:** open a title’s **More → Smart phone downloads** menu and enable **Auto-download**. The default buffer is three unread chapters; choose 1, 3, 5, 10, or 20 in **Phone downloads → Settings**.
- **Clean up after synchronization:** automatic phone copies can be removed after fresh server state confirms they are read and pending chapter changes have synchronized. Uncertain or failed progress keeps the copy available. Manually saved chapters and server downloads are preserved.
- **Follow existing transfer rules:** smart downloads respect Wi-Fi-only transfers, pause/resume, and the phone storage limit. Queues and selected titles survive app restarts. Disabling a title cancels unfinished automatic transfers and keeps completed copies.
- **Stay current with the server:** selected titles are checked hourly, after progress synchronizes, when viewing a title, and when connectivity returns. Android may delay background work; the server’s normal library updates still fetch new chapters from providers.

## Clearer download controls

- **Downloads and Settings tabs:** view saved chapters grouped by title, see storage usage, and manage transfer rules without one long mixed list. Each tab keeps its scroll position.
- **Compact chapter actions:** tap a completed chapter to read offline; use its overflow menu to remove a phone copy, with a named confirmation.
- **Simpler smart-download dialog:** clearer toggle, full-width explanation, direct access to settings, saving feedback, and visible errors.
- **Better small-screen layouts:** shorter descriptions, accessible switch and radio controls, singular chapter labels, and layouts checked with enlarged text and landscape orientation.

## Validation

Formatting and debug builds passed, along with the full release unit-test suite. ADB checks covered the OnePlus interface and isolated emulator scenarios for automatic refill, sync-gated cleanup, Wi-Fi and storage restrictions, restart recovery, settings, offline reading, removal, and error recovery.

## Install or update

Requires **Android 8.0+**. Download **`Yomira-v0.5.0-universal.apk`** if unsure which APK to choose; `arm64-v8a` suits most current phones. Checksums are in `SHA256SUMS.txt`.

Install over an earlier signed Yomira or Komikku Suwayomi release to keep app data. Package **`app.komikku.suwayomi`** and the release signing key are unchanged. Debug builds and upstream Komikku remain separate apps.

A Suwayomi server is required for browsing and fetching new chapters. Completed **phone downloads** can be read offline; **server downloads** remain on the server. Features depend on server API support and account permissions.

Yomira is an independent fork. Upstream credits remain in the app and repository. Upstream telemetry and app-update integration remain disabled.
